tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje legs ldan ma'i sku phebs skabs thod bcings// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dgongs brda' snyan brgyud rigs 'dzin/ lhag pa'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar glo bo ged dkar gtsug lag khang gi srung ma rdo rje legs ldan ma nyid gzugs can khog brlams kyis 'phral yun lung gis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa zhig yod 'dug pa bzhin sku khog rnams la rdo rje legs ldan ma nyid byon nas lung ston pa las gzhan log par lta ba brdzus ma'i rigs mi 'byung ba'i phrin las rdo rje legs ldan ma nyid kyis mdzod cig sa ma ya na ra kan/ zhes glo bo rgyal po a haṃ dbang rgyal rdo rje nas legs ldan ma'i sku phebs skabs thod bcings 'tshams su dkri ba'i dam bzhag cig dgos gsung pa bzhin sa skya pa kun blo kha bdar can des bris// ༄༅/ /swāsti/ glo bo rgyal po'i srung ma mdung dmar can bse khrab can sogs dang gcig min zhes 'phros pas gcig par byas te de'i gsol mchod ni/ gtor ma bzhengs na khrag chang tsam pa las zan gtor gru gsum rtse zur shin tu rno ba che ba gcig la chung ba brgyad bskor mthar sha khrag sogs zas snas bskor ba dang / sha mar rgyan khrag gam smug rtsi byugs mdun phud chang sogs btung ba sna tshogs bskor ba dang / yang na phyed tshugs chang gis chog chang gis sbyang / spos dkar dang bsang shing gis bdug la/ ngag 'don ni/ bla ma yi dam dang / /mkha' 'gro rtsa gsum lha/ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs la/ /sgo gsum skyabs su mchi/ /lan gsum sogs/ sems can bde don du/ /rnam bzhi'i phrin las phyir/ /pad+ma dbang chen bsgom/ /mdung dmar gsol phrin bgyi/ /lan gsum/ rnam dag spros bral las/ /spros pa'i skur shar ba/ /rang nyid dbang chen khro/ /dmar 'jigs khro rgyal can/

/be con 'phyar sdigs mdzub/ /khyung gshog can brkyang bskum/ /pad nyi'i gdan la rol/ /zhes dang / hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ mchod gtor bsangs sbyang dag /thod snod sha khrag sogs/ /srung ma gang dgyes rdzas/ /zag med bdud rtsir gyur/ /kye kye swa swa dgongs/ /glo bo'i rgyal rgyud dang / /de'i mnga' 'bangs kyi/ /lha sde mi sde yi/ /snod bcud dpal 'byor gyi/ /bgegs srung legs spel ba/ /bstan srung mdung dmar can/ /'dir byon bdag la dgongs/ /khyod thugs dgyes bskyed kyi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rdzas/ /sngon gyi thugs dam gyi// //zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rdo rje legs ldan ma'i sku phebs skabs thod bcings/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
